sources.title: CouchDB replication introduction

sources.locator: Transient/persistent replication; procedure; master-master; migrating data to clients
sources.observed_operation: Read replication directions, checkpoints and filter conditions.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Each replication is directional; bidirectional sync needs two replications; deletes replicate as new revisions; content-based filters see deleted docs without their original body; a workaround retaining all data is noted.

sources.title: CouchDB conflict model
sources.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
sources.locator: Sections conflict avoidance, revision trees, working with conflicting documents and views
sources.observed_operation: Read normal write rejection, winner visibility, conflict retrieval and app-specific merge behavior.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Same-node stale revision can return 409; replicas may retain branches; ordinary GET/view expose the deterministic winner; application must inspect and resolve branches; compaction drops non-leaf bodies.
sources.applicability: Supports caution that replication and deterministic winner selection are not a domain resolution.

sources.title: CouchDB changes-feed API
sources.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
sources.locator: Query parameters include_docs, attachments, style; _changes defaults
sources.observed_operation: Read feed modes and defaults affecting sync, conflict visibility and attachments.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: include_docs=false and attachments=false by default; include_docs with conflicts still returns only the winner; main_only is the default style; base64 inline attachments have overhead and only recent changes per doc are guaranteed.
sources.applicability: Supports summary/sync design and the recommendation not to inline large photo bytes in the change feed.

sources.title: CouchDB database security API

sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Members read all document types in the database and write ordinary documents; an empty member/role set can leave ordinary docs readable/writable; new CouchDB 3.x databases default admin-only.
sources.applicability: Shows database membership is not record-level privacy; keep contact data out of shared records or mediate by narrower API.

critic_dispositions.rationale: Raw searchable free text can contain contact details; CouchDB database membership is not per-field protection. Require reviewed safe-search projections, no raw snippets, server-side authorization, and fail-closed exclusion.

The directly reopened PR page shows both Checks 0 in the tab and a historical 56 checks passed merge event. The investigator's historical statement is supported; the critic's view of the tab alone does not negate the event. No local tests were run.
